newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: IDB's Unit Investment Fund lifts 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: IDB's Unit Investment Fund lifts 1996 net.

text.p: The Unit Investment Fund, a wholly-owned affiliate of the Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank (IDB), on Sunday reported net income of $25.25 million in 1996, up from $23.24 million in 1995.
It said net asset value per unit stood at $1.08956 at end-1996, down from $1.09070 at end-1995.

A bank statement quoted president Ahmed Mohammed Ali as saying the executive committee of the fund recommended the distribution of $19.75 million as an interim dividend to unitholders. It gave no comparative figure.
The fund has a paid-in capital of $350 million and operates as a vehicle to mobilise funds for the IDB to boost economic development in its Islamic member states.
